name: Sunday Night Slam Masters (1/10/99)

date.source: The promotion's own eight-part broadcast posting, dated 10-12 January 1999 and headlined "Live from Norfolk, Virginia! The January 10, 1999 episode!"

matches.note: "The Lobo" Jeremy Rhodes defeated "El Diablo" Eddie Deegan with the Lobo Snap.
Chameleon defeated Kenny Smith with the Identity Check, after interference broke up a run-in by Kenny Smith's own allies.
Death Master defeated Harbringer with the TrUth, after Harbringer's own second, Kenny Smith, was struck down by Death Master's manager.
"Big Dog" Justin Russell defeated Vincent "The Zombie" Maxim with a vertical superplex.
Sex and Violence defeated Pope Sixtus the Sixth and Cardinal Syn when Damon Harris pinned Cardinal Syn following a tandem move the team called There's No Sex In This Violence.

name: Sunday Night Slam Masters (2/8/99)

date.source: The promotion's own five-part broadcast posting, dated 8 February 1999.

matches.note: For the Light Heavyweight title. Crash Domino submitted the champion with the Mercy Point in a record 1:37, in his first match back after time away from the sport.
Ian Bradley retained the Television title, using brass knuckles to knock out Jeremy Rhodes.
Insane Wayne retained the United States title by submission with the Str8 Jacket.

The Deegans won the World Tag Team titles from The Cult, with the deciding fall made by a referee brought down during the brawl after the assigned referee was knocked out; a promotion board member fined the interfering manager afterward.
